idiom.title: Keyed up
idiom.interpretationEn: This idiom originates from the 19th century. The original meaning involved making something taut or ready by turning a key or a string, such as winding a clock or tuning an instrument. Figuratively, it describes the state of being excited or anxious in anticipation of something.
idiom.interpretationZh: “Keyed up” 起源于 19 世纪，原意是通过扭动钥匙或者用弦来使某些东西（如时钟或乐器）紧绷或者准备好。引申义上，这个短语形象地比喻了人们因为即将发生的事情而感到激动或紧张的状态。

examples.en: She was all keyed up before her big presentation.
examples.zh: 她在大演讲前非常紧张。

examples.en: He gets keyed up every time he has an important meeting.
examples.zh: 每当他有重要会议时，他都会变得非常紧张。

examples.en: The kids were all keyed up waiting for the fireworks to start.
examples.zh: 孩子们都激动地等待烟火开始。

people.name: Denise Crosby
people.extract: Denise Michelle Crosby is an American actress and model known for portraying Security Chief Tasha Yar mainly in season one of Star Trek: The Next Generation, and Yar's daughter, the half-Romulan Commander Sela, in subsequent seasons. She is also known for her numerous film and television roles and for starring in and producing the 1997 film Trekkies.
highlights: Portrayed Security Chief Tasha Yar in Star Trek: The Next Generation.
Played Commander Sela in Star Trek: The Next Generation.
Starred in and produced the 1997 film Trekkies.

people.name: Dale Carnegie
people.extract: Dale Carnegie was an American writer and teacher of courses in self-improvement, salesmanship, corporate training, public speaking, and interpersonal skills. Born into poverty on a farm in Missouri, he was the author of How to Win Friends and Influence People (1936), a bestseller that remains popular today. He also wrote How to Stop Worrying and Start Living (1948), Lincoln the Unknown (1932), and several other books.
highlights: Authored bestseller How to Win Friends and Influence People.
Wrote How to Stop Worrying and Start Living.
Taught self-improvement, salesmanship, public speaking, and interpersonal skills courses.

people.name: Christian Wirth
people.bio: Nazi German police chief and extermination camp commandant (1885–1944)
people.extract: Christian Wirth was a German Schutzstaffel (SS) officer and leading Holocaust perpetrator who was one of the primary architects of the program to exterminate the Jewish people of Poland, known as Operation Reinhard. His nicknames included Christian the Cruel, Stuka, and The Wild Christian due to the extremity of his behaviour among the SS and Trawniki guards and to the camp inmates and victims.
